verdict.rationale: Nix ships its own isolation for testing: VM-based integration tests (nix-docs-10, nix-docs-31), isolated shells via nix-shell and nix develop (nix-docs-2, nix-docs-3), and builds that only see explicitly declared dependencies (nix-docs-59). Atomic, rollback-able changes (nix-docs-50, nix-docs-7) and temporary installs (nix-comm-7) let users experiment without disturbing the existing system. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses separating test runs from production data, and nothing is agent-oriented. missing for 10: documented isolation of test runs from production data or services, depth on how the VM test sandbox works, agent-facing sandbox workflows, independent hands-on corroboration of sandboxed testing.
